messages.text: What did we decide about Redis last week?

You settled it in the Design review: adopt Redis for the caching layer, with pub-sub support as the deciding factor [meeting:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111@0:12]. Cluster mode was deferred until failover latency is benchmarked [meeting:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111@0:38].

Two follow-ups came out of it: you are drafting the eviction-policy document by Thursday, and the failover benchmark is booked with the search team's load harness [meeting:00000006-0000-4000-8000-000000000006].
